newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares close down on poor sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares close down on poor sentiment.

text.p: Shanghai B shares ended down slightly on Wednesday on poor sentiment in the absense of market-moving news to boost investor interest, brokers said.
The index edged down 0.004 points or 0.01 percent to 48.692 points on volume of 5.4 million shares worth $1.8 million. Of 41 B shares, 32 traded with 12 down, nine flat and 11 up.
Brokers said that buying of Pudong shares early in the session had little impact in improving market sentiment.
"Few investors have real interest in buying shares currently given the gloomy market mood," one broker said.
"The market is still on a downward track with overseas investors withdrawing their capital from the market despite the occasional rebound," another broker said.
Shanghai Diesel Engine was the worst performer on expectation of poor prospects, falling $0.014 or 3.33 percent to $0.406 on volume of 167,000 shares.

Shanghai Refrigerator Compressor traded the most on overseas selling, but one institution was seen giving it firm support, brokers said. It rose $0.002 or 0.43 percent to $0.464 on volume of 711,000 shares.
Shanghai A shares closed down on a technical correction with investors cautious about buying at the current high levels, brokers said.

The A index dipped 3.863 points or 0.42 percent to 917.409 points on volume of 490.3 million shares worth 4.2 billion yuan. The SSE 30 blue-chip edged down 1.989 points or 0.08 percent to 2427.069 points.
Newcomer Hainan Overseas was the biggest loser on profit-taking selling, falling 1.10 yuan or 6.78 percent to 15.30 yuan on volume of 3.8 million shares.
